ne tshan brgyad pa/ dga' 'dzoms khrud kyai skya snang / 81 tshan dgu pa/ rang dbang gi khrod nas slar yang gzhan dbang du rgyur ba/ 91bo tshan bcu pa/ rgyal khams 'grims pa'i la zla/ 1༷3

dpar skrun gsal meshad/'dzam gling go la'i steng 'bur du don pa'i bod kha ba gangs can gyi ljongs 'di nyid spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya phrag du ma nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung / yul goms bakhres lugs/ sa cha'i gnas babs sags sgo gang sa nas rang btsan gtsang ma'i rgyal khab cig yin pa bsnyon med rtsod bral yin yang rgya nag gong ma rim byon skabs bod rgya gnyis mchod yan gyi 'brel lam de brgyud bod 'di ches snga mo zhig nas rgya 'og tu 'khyur mid gtong sems kyi re ngan thabs brgya jus stong byas yad rung / dngos su spyi lo 1949 nas 'go btsugs kyis mthar 1959lar rgya nag dmar gzhung nas zhi bde snying 'jags su gnas pa'i bod chos ldan gyi zhing khams yongs su drag po'i btsan 'dzul gyis gtor bcom 'phrog gsum gyi sgo nas bod kyi rgyal rabs la rgyus nang byung myong med pa'i khrag gi 'khor la bskor/ bod mi rnams gzhis byes gnyis su gyes te dus de nas bzung bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar rol rgyu lta ci/ 'jig rten 'dir dmyal ba mun nag gi sdug bsngal sto11

ngapa ra skrun gsal bshad/ gnyis/tshad las 'das pa myangs dgos byung ba red/rgya dmar gyis bod nang thog mar btsan 'dzul byed skabs bod la rogs ram bya rgyu'i kha g.yang bsgrags kyang don dngos thog lo ngo stong phrag mang po'i ring gsog 'jogs byas pa'i bod kyi chos shes dpal gsum dang / yul goms gzhis lugs/ rang byung skye dngos rtsi shing / gter rigs khag ming gi lhag mar btang ba ma zad/ bod mi 'bum bcu gsum la nye ba dus min rkyen 'das su btang ba dang shul lhag bod mi tshor rig gnas gsar brje zer ba sogs ming sna tshogs btags nas btson bcug dang do dam/ 'thab rtsod dang slob gso sogs kyis nyin 'khyol yang mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i dka' sdug gi lo zla de dus deng sang yang myong bzhin yad /⑩spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas gsum cu'i dus dran thengs 28 thog bstsal ba'i bka' slob nang / de snga so so rang nyid kyi thog la gnas tshul mang po zhig byung ba dang / de bzhin gzhan zer rjes 'brangs ma yin pa'i khungs ldan gyi gnas tshul rang gis mthong thos byung ba dag tshang mas do snang chen pos yig thog tu 'god dgos/ de 'dra ma byas na/ gnas tshul sdug bsngal ji snyed rang thog myangs pa'i mi mang po zhig rim bzhin rdzogs 'gro yi yad/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus skabs shig la de'i dri de'i dus sdug po zhe po zhig 511

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ gsum/byung ba red ces spom tshig tsam ma gtogs gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa'i gnas tshul zhib tshags su la'ang bshad rgyu med pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten dngos byung la rgyus rgyas bsdus gang yin yang yig thog la bkod de yig cha mang tsam 'don thabs byed dgos/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgangs don dang / lhag par btsan byol spyi tshogs nang tshogs sde dang mi sger gang rung nas deb rigs sna tshogs par skrun byas dang byed bzhin yad na yang las gzhi 'di'i thog dmigs bkar phyag las gnang mkhan med khar/ rang yul bod nang gzhi rtsa'i smra bajiod rang dbang tsam yang med na mi tshe'i la rgyus ngag rgyun tsam las yig thog 'god rgyu shin tu dka' bas skyed sdug mi 'dra ba rgyud pa'i mi tshe'i dngos byung gi la rgyus de dag dang thog rang gi skad yig thog gsog sgrub bgyis te 'di nas bod dbyin gnyis thog rim pas dpar 'grems byed thub na/ la rgyus deb phreng kha thor du mi 'gro bar rjes rab klag pa po rnams la 'tshol bde dang / de bzhin mgon po gang nyid kyi dgangs gzhi rlabs po che sgrub thub pa ma zad/ bod kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus rtsom sgrig dpar skrun gyi stong cha bskang thub pa sogs la dmigs te 'di ga tshogs pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyis las gzhi 'di 'go 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng bcu bzhi dpar skrun zin pa da nga da dung par skrun zhu 'char mang dag cig yad khongs nas da res chab srid btson pa'i 15

dpar skrun gsal bshad/ bzhi/la rgyus deb phreng bcu bdun pa 'di bzhin a ṇi dpal chen sgrol ma'i la rgyus (7char chung khrod kyi me gapa/ zhes pa dngos su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis rgyal spyi'i steng bod don thog rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dang / de bzhin bod nang gi yid skyo ba'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib gnang mkhan rnams la lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhir thugs phan sos re/ lhag par bod phyi nang du gnas pa'i rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams la rgan rabs tshos bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad pa gsal rtogs kyis mes po'i khrag rgyun ded nas bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gso'i don du zungs khrag gsar pa zhig sbyin thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yod/da lan deb phreng bcu bdun pa 'dir dpal ldan dril bsgrags las khungs nas ched bajiod bka' drin bstsal ba dang / lhag par la rgyus kyi bdag po dang rtsom sgrig pa/ 'di ga'i las byed yangs nas phyar gru mnyam 'degs gnang ba'i 'bras bus mthar par skrun zin par bcos min snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ka tsha ngag dbang 'od 'bar gyis/spyi lo 20༷7 zla 7 tshes 30 nyin/5

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng merdod/'di ni bod mi sger pa zhig gi me tshe'i lo rgyus yin kyang / khong gi mi tshe'i 'gyur ldog thams cad ni bod kyi deng rabs kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed par rin thang ldan pa'i dpyad gzhi gal chen zhig red/ yin na'ang / nga tshos khong gi mi che'i lo rgyus 'di bzhin phyogs sgrig dang dngos gzhi'i dpar skrun gyi las gzhi'i khongs su 'jog skabs stabs ma legs par khong 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du gshegs zin par rten 'brel yad kyi dka' gnad mang po zhig dang / lhag par du khong btsan byol du phebs pa'i rjes rgyal spyi'i thog bod don dril bsgrags dang chab srid kyi byed sgo mang po'i nang du 'dzul zhugs byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams la rgyus kyi nang 'god thub ma song bas klog pa po rnams kyis dgongs bzhes gnang bar mkhyen/ da res phyogs sgrig byas pa'i lo rgyus 'di ni de snga khong la bca' 'dri zhus pa'i ma zin nang gang 'khod pa dag gtso bor bzung ba'i thog nas tshig sbyor mi bde ba dang / go rim 'khrugs snu1

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brdzod/ drugapa/ chad lus shor ba sogs kyi gnas tshul rnams la rang nus gang yod kyis legs sgrig byas pa yin/lo rgyus kyi rtsaba'i byung rim gyi ngos nas bshad na a ṇi dpal chen sgrol mas thog mar rgya nag gis bod la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i rgyud rim gyi nang khams pa'i yul dmag dang mnyam du/ bod kyi rgyal srung dmag 'thab kyi nang du zhugs pa dang / skabs re pha rol po pham pa dang skabs re rang nyid pham pa sogs bzo chun gyi 'khor lo bskor ba lta bu'i dmag 'thab grangs med brgyab pa'i mthar/ mi dmangs kyis sgrig 'dzugs byas pa'i yul dmag rnams rgya dmag gi bskor rgya'i nang du tshud pa dang chabs cig khong dang khong gi 'thab grogs rnams rgya dmag gi lag par thebs te mi lo nyi shu tsam gyi ring khong gi gces pa'i gzhon nu'i lang tsho de rgya nag gi btson khang nang du rdzogs/dus skabs de'i ring khong gis mi rnams kyis mthong myong med pa dang / thos myong med pa/ myangs ma myongs ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'khur po grangs las 'das pa zhig khong gi lus sems gnyis la 'khur dgos byung ba red/ tsha grang bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba'i btson khang gi lo zlas khong la mnar gcod dang phogs thug ci 'dra zhig btang yang / khong gis rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs la bcangs pa'i rgyal zhen lhag bsam la g.ya 'gul gang yang thebs med/snu11

rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng brjod/ bdun/mdor na/ khong gi lo rgyus ni bod kyi spud kyi lo rgyus kyi deb ther nang du 'god rin yad pa'i rlabs chen gyi mi sna zhig yin par rten/ rlabs chen mi sna'i lo rgyus la slob sbyong byas te dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi spud dang na gzhon tshos sngar dran deng bsdur gyi thog nas bod mi'i rang dbang 'thab rtsod kyi las 'gul de skas rim gsar pa zhig tu slebs ched lag gdang sbrel nas mdun du bskyod cigartsom sgrig pas/spyi lo 2007 zla ba 8 tshes 21 nyin/5111

char rnung khrod kyai mee stag55

dang po/pha mes kyi rigs ༷nyis /bdag gi chung dus kyi 'tsho ba ni dro skyid dang spuo snang ldan pa zhig ma yin par rang gi pha mes kyis bzhag pa'i sa khang sa zhing dang sgo phyugs sems can tsam ma zad/ lo rgyus yun ring ldan la ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i dgon sde dang lha khang / rig gnas dngos rdzas dang sku gsung thugs rten sogs rgya nag gzhung kkas rtsamed bzos pa dang / gangs ljongs yul lung kun du rgan gzhon dang pho mo dbye ba med par dmar gsod btang ste 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus kyi steng du mthong dkon pa'i skyo gnas kyi rma kha chen po zhig bzos/ 'a ngo brgya phrag du ma'i gong rol du bod du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lubs dar spel btang ba des bod mi yongs kyi bsam blo'i nang rang bzhin nyid nas byams pa dang ༈ snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i ming don mtshungs pa'i chos ldan gyi zhing khams dngos yin pa dang / rgya nag ni de las ldog ste mi gsod khrag sbyor dang / kho tsho'i dar cha dmar po de'i 'ob/ nas mi grangs 'bum phrag mang po'i tshe srog bcad yad/1

2 char rlung khrod kyi me stagadus skabs de'i ring nga tshor yad pa'i rang dbang ni ltogs shi thebs pa dang / rang shi rgyag pa/ mi sha dang rta sha/ de bzhin gsang gcod nang gi btsog pa dang / ko ba sbang nas bza' ba sogs tsha grang bkres skom gyi dus skabs de dus da lta'ang mi rnams kyi brjed thub kyi med/bdag gi pha yul mdo stod go 'jo ni yongs grags su stod mnga' ris skor gsum dang / bar gyi dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad kyi mdo khams sgang drug ces dbye srol yad pa dang / de yang dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi chol kha dang / mdo stod mgo nag mi yi chol kha/ mdo smud gyi ling rta yi chol kha bcas ni bod mi tshos mi rabs nas mi rabs bar kha rgyun du 'jags pa'i nges srol zhig dang / bod mi tshos yul lung bye brag so se'i khyad chos la che bstod byas pa zhig kyang red/ mdo stod chu bzhi sgang drug gi ya gyal gla chu dang 'bri chu'i bar gyi smar khams zhes yongs su grags pa'i sa yi gong ba'am ༷/la gyi phur chags pa go 'khro'i yul 'di nyid yin zhing / rgan po rnams kyi bajiod srol ltar na yul phyogs 'dir bkris 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i yul zhig yin pas na go 'khro'i yul zhes thogs par grags/ bod kyi ming grags che ba'i dpa' bo'i lo rgyus kyi sgrung gtam nang grags pa rab tu 'bar ba'i gling rje ge sar rgyal po gang gi sku dus su gling lha sde dkar po'i dan rtags/ gling chung rgyud 'bum pa'i gdung sras/ dgra lha rtse rgyal gyi mi rgyud ma nyams pa'i lding dpon bkris khang gsar/ seng stag 2

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 3rgyud pa dpa' la dpon tshang sogs rmug po ldong gi mi rgyud bar ma chad par dus da lta'ang yad/rgyal mchog lda pa chen pos bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa dang / gangs ljongs mi rigs kyi bla na med pa'i bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi lugs zung gi srid dbang dbu brnyes rjes bod kyi chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ chos lugs sogs spyi tshogs kyi bya don dang byed sgo khag de bzhin gzhung gi gal che'i mdzwad byus dang srid jus sogs la phyogs yangs nas bskyar sgrig dang dag ther rim par mdzwad de/ lda la lnga dpon dang /bcu la bcu dpon/ sde la sde dpon/ yul la rdzong dpon sogs ma lag ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhung gi sgrig gzhi khag gtan 'bebs mdzad pa ltar/ mchog tu gyur ba'i bdag gi pha yul go 'jo'i yul 'dir yang sde dpon bsko bzhag mdzad pa dang / khral bsdu dang dmag mi/ khrims kyi 'gro lugs sogs bkod sgrig gnang sde dga' ldan pho brang gi mnga' zhabs dwangs ma zhig la gyur/dus skabs de 'dra'i nang go rdzong bsam grub stag rtse'i pho brang gsar bzhengs mdzad pa dang / rdzong dpon yang skya ser gang rung rim bzhin brje len mdzad de yul khams khyon yangs la rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong gnang mdzad pa dang / gsang sngags 'gro 'dren gling pa ni mi dbang chen po sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs dang / dga' ldan pho brang 3

4 char rlung khrod kyi me stagachen po'i chab srid nyer 'tshe'i mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung gi kha gnon 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub pa'i sde btsugs te rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling nas mkhan po mkhas btsun rgya mtsho bla mar bsko bzhag mdzad de bshad sgrub las gsum gyi bstan pa bskyangs/ grwa dmangs rnams la'ang 'bru phogs sprad pa sogs gzhung dgon gyi gras su bzhag pa dang / de ni rgyal ba lnga pas dgon gsar btab pa'i ya gyal zhig yin zhing / dus skabs der sde la spyi dpon zhes yul khams stod smad rang rang gi sde yi skyed sdug la dbang bsgyur/ go 'khro'i lding dpon bcu gnyis sam deng skabs mngon gsal lding dpon dgu zhes sngon gyi mi rgyud las chad pas ya rabs kyi srol la dga' zhing / spyod gtsang gzhung drang gi thog nas rang gi chab 'bangs mi ser skyong mkhas pa/ dpa' rtsal che zhing tīl phod che bas dgra sde gzhom la dpa' ba'i mi pho ya rabs sha stag yin la/ rang rang gi 'og la legs spel nges sel byed mkhan gyi dpon por mnga' gsol te/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gis bka' shel tham lag tu bzhag thob 'phru tog mgo la btsugs te sde rang thob chos bzhin skyong ba la/ tshar bcad rjes 'dzin chog pa'i lding dpon du dbang bskur bas gong gi bka' bzhin sgrub/'og sde byams pas skyong / 'bangs mi dpon la bskos/ phyi 'jam nang skyed sogs mi slon rang skyid kyi gnas la 'khod pa zhig byung ngo /4

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 5de yang las dang smon lam bzang po'i mthu dang nus pa'i rgyu las rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa dang dus mnyam du/ snga 'gyur rnying ma'i gdan sa ma dgon chen po drug gi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur ste/ mdo khams sa yi thig ler 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i bod kyi 'gro ba rnams kyang rmad byung bsod nams kyi byin rlabs khyad du 'phags pa de dag la rten nas bde skyed kyi dpal la ci gar rol ba'i bskal ba bzang po thob pa ni de bas kyang smos med red/go 'jo ni lho nas nub phyogs su 'bab pa'i slar chu dang / nub nas shar gyi phyogs su 'bab pa'i ri chu zhes pa'i chu chen gnyis kyi g.yas g.yan du chags shing / smar chu'i chu rgyud du rim par stod lding gsum dang / bar lding gsum rnams chags shing / ri chu'i smad rgyud du slad lding gsum zhes pa chags/lung tshan so so'i phu la rang rang gi 'brog sde dang / mda' ru rong sde rnams ngo mtshar bkod pa legs pa'i tshul du chags shing / ri yi mgul du ngo mtshar dben gnas kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i ri khrod dang / dgon sde rnams brjid chags lta na sdug pa'i ngang tshul du gnas/ go 'khro'i shar du sa ngan re khe yad la sa mi 'gyur ba'i dan rtags dpa' yi dmu rdo sum btsugs dang / lho ru slar khams sog sde dang sa mi 'gyur ba'i dan rtags snar ma'i la kha chu bgos dang / nub tu nyag bre'am brag g.yab sa mi 'gyur ba'i dan rtags mtshams kyi ma ni 'bru drug5

6 char rlung khrod kyi me stagabyang du sde dge dang sa mi 'gyur ba'i dan rtags sde dge'i mu ge la kha bcas yin tshul bshad srol yod/ lho nub kyi chu bo chen po rnams gnyis a dkar sha ru mdor mnyam du 'dzoms nas byang phyogs su babs te sde dge nyag bzhes phyogs nas 'bri chur 'bab bo/de yang snod lung pa'i stod spad rnams su bcud sde dpon chags stangs dang mthun par ming yang stod lding gsum dang / bar lding gsum/ smad lding gsum zhes grags pa dang / stod lding dang po le mda' lding 'og la 'brog pa'i sa khul/ smar phu gzhung shes sa bzang gi gong ba yin ces bshad cing smar chu'i chu phud du gyur/ smar khams sgang gi sa yi rtse mo/ mtho btsan pa'i ri bo yul skyong lha gnyan chen po smar lhag snang ba g.yu rtsezhes go smar phyogs kyi lha klu gzhis bdag kun gyi mdun gyi sna 'dren pa ded dpon gyi tshul du yad cing / de yi mdun zhol sogs su a dbang 'brog sde khag gsum dang / mdo drug stod pa shog chen khag dang / g.yu sgra shog sogs rong sde khang zhing bdag po/ sde khag chen po bcu bdun/ sde mi zhig pa'i dpon la le mda' lding dpon tshang ngam spom mda' dpon tshang zhes nga rang gi khyim tshang de red/phyi dgra nang du mi shor/ rang sde byams skyong che ba/ nang sde phyi ru mi gre/tong / lha chos la blo phugs gtad pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po mi rabs mang dag cig byung yod 'dug mchod gnas ni gtsobo dngul ra dgon pa/ bsod 6

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 7nams rin chen gyi gdan sa 'dir gter ston bzang po rdo rje zhes gang zag khyad par can gter chos thog mkhas grub karma ma chags med/ rig 'dzin kun bzang thes rab sogs kyi zhal slob rtogs ldan lhun grub rin dzin zhes sgrub khang la zangs thal du bakhregs bzhugs nus pa sogs rnam thar bsam gyis mai khyab pa des ra ma dgon pa phyag btab/ 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i snang byed mdo khams pa karma bstan 'phel sogs kyi zhal slob rdo rdzong dkon mchog rgyal po'i sku phreng na rim gyi dgon pa mdo sngags rab rgyas chos gling / 'di yi sku phreng drug pa la rdo rdzong grub smyon zhes snang sems la rang dbang 'byor bas 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa gang la'ang nyams mi nga ba byung yad/ rmugs sangs mkhan rin po che pad ma shes rab bzang pos kha legs dgon pa 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas khyad par can slob ma mang che ba jo ser rnams gtso bo rdzogs pa chen po'i ltasgom la brtson nas 'das grongs su gyur skabs mang che ba thugs dam la bzhugs pa byung yad/ rnying ma'i chos rgyud rgod mgo dgon pa/ rang 'go dgon pa bcas la skyabs gnas dam par 'dzin te bstan pa la zhabs 'degs lhag par che'o/gnyis pa khang sar lding 'og la lho ru lha thog 'brog sde dang / byang du sbra nag 'brog sde khag gsum/ rong sde la mdo drug smad pa wa a mgon rong pa sogs rong sde khag mang po yad/ lding dpon khang sar dpon tshang gling dgra lha rtsergyal mi brgyud du brtsi/ khang gsar mgon rdor dpa' rtsal lus la 'joms/7

8 char rlung khrod kyi me stagadagra sde zil gyis gnon/ bcos ma'i g.ya sgyu spangs/ khog drang zhing dbul phongs la byams skyong che/ mi rgyud khyad du 'phags pa sha stag byung yad/ mchod gnas dgon sde dngul ra dgon pa rnying dgon 'od gsal khang sar dpon mgon rdor zer ba de skad grags can zhig byung 'dug dus da lta'ang khong gi mdzad spyod rnams rgan rabs pa dag gis 'grel bajiod byed skabs khong gi mdun du mi tshogs 'dus nas nyan dus sgrung gtam ji bzhin snyan 'arjebs ldan par snang /sngon gyi mi rabs rnams ni drang po dang / mgo bde dran 'khrul med pa/ ya rabs spyod bzang / spyi dgra la dpa' mi zhum pa blo khog che ba de dang de lta bu zhes bsngags brjod byed kyi yod/ khong la buo gnyis yod pa las gcig nga tsho'i sar mna' mar btang 'dug cig shos de gig rong gter chen bsod rgyal gyi mkha' 'gro red/ khong go 'jo khul ched du phebs nas khang gsar dpon tshang gi nye 'gram smar chu'i zam pa dang nye bar gur zhig phub nas dpon g.yog kha shas byas te bzhugs rjes buo slong bar btang 'dug rgyu mtshan mang po drangs nas thengs mang gsungs yang khas ma blangs pa red/ mthar nga'i buo khyed la sprod dgos na/ mi mang tshang ma 'dzoms sar tshang mas mthong sar khrom gter bzhes dgos/de ltar byung na nga yi buo khyed la sprad chog ces zhus/ pha yi bsam par de tsam rang byed rgyu yad mi yang bsam 'dug ces/ bla mas/ 'o/ rten 'brel bzang po byung song / de ltar byed chog gsungs nas skabs de dus bla ma la snyan 8

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 9grags de tsam med pa red/ nga tsho dang khang gsar dpon gnyis kyi bar ya rong nang zer ba'i lung pa zhig yad/ der sa cha tshub po gcod pa rnams kyi gnyen sa gcod srol yad/ der gur phub sgar brgyab nas gter chen bsod rgyal rin po ches tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor/ dpon tshang ma/gon rdor gyi buo nang mi dang / nga tshe'i nang mi sogs mi brgya phrag 'dus pa de'i nye 'gram du brag chen po zhig yad pa de'i sar phebs nas brag de'i ngos la ri mo zhig bris gnang nas der rkos gsungs/ rko dus 'bigs khag po byung tshe bla mas buo la/ bro lags/ ga par yad sa red 'dug gsungs dus/ bu mo des 'dir yad pa 'dug ces phyag mdzub btsug/sa sa der thengs gnyis gsum ma gtogs zhu ma dgos par mgo thar tsam zhig nag yug ger byung / de'i nang sbrul zhig gis gter rnams bcug nas bsdad yad par/ sbrul des mgo ke rer langs bzhin srab cing mkhregs pa'i lce sring bzhin 'dug skabs der bsod rgyal rin po che nas dpon mgon rdor shog gsungs nas/ gter 'di tshur lon cig gsung dus/ mgon rdor nas 'di dngos yad red dam dngos med red ces bla mar zhu dus/ bla mas dngos yad ma red na 'bum gsungs pas khong len ma nus/gter chen rin po ches sku sged nas sged phur de bzhes nas sbrul la tshad tsam mardod dus/ sprul de brag nang du shur shur phyin song / rin po ches phyag dri bzang gis bkrus/ dar gyis bcug nas sku 'dra dang / gter sgrom tshur bzhes/9

10 char rlung khrod kyi me stagashul du da dung yad pa 'di nga yi skal ba min/ gzhan gyi red gsungs nas bzhagagater tshab sbas rjes yang sged phur de tshad tsam mdzad dus sngar ltar sgrul de yong nas/ gter de rnams la bcud nas bsngad song zer/ brag khung rtsig pa brtsigs/de nas gter chen rin po che'i phyag gis sa ro rdo ro rnams sbas gong rtsig pa de byug tsam gnang ma thag sdon brkos pa'i rjes tsam med pa byung song gsungs/ gter sgrom de bu me'i skra zhig khur shog gsungs nas/ skra nyag ma gcig la lcogs nyag rong nas yin pa tshul khrims sba ra zhes dgung lo brgyad bcu gya lngar phebs pa khong dang sku mched gnyis nas nga chung dus skabs la bshad byung / khong sku mched gnyis khang gsar dpon tshang dang / nga yi nang dpon mda' tshang gnyis nang la yar mar sngod res gnang gi yad/ rgyal mchog sku phreng gnyis pa'i sku dus su smad nyag gi yul grur gzhung sa chen pos dpung 'jug mdzwad skabs gzhung sa nas gnas chung chos rgyal chen po'i lung bzhin go stod rag dgon thub bstan kun bzang 'od gsal gling gi rig 'dzin chos dbyings 'gyur med dpung mjug chen po'i dbu skyong bka' blon phu lung dang mda' dpon khri smon sogs kyi dbu bla mi lo gsum bar du phebs/ gzhan sde rmeg med du 'joms pa'i las sbyor mdzad/ bdud sde dag bod chen po'i mnga' 'bangs su 'dus/ rig 'dzin chos dbyings 'gyur med la gzhung sa chen po nas gzengs rtags stsal/sku phreng na rim dang rag sprul rdo rje 'chang thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya mtshos sangs 0

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 11rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang / bod gangs to pa'i bstan srid thugs la btags te kla blo'i dpung chen nyams dmas par byas pa'i las sbyor mdzwad par grags/khong ni rgya mi'i dka' sdug gi 'og nas sdug bsngal mang po myangs pa zhig yin pa dang / dam pa de rnams kyi yang sprul thub bstan bshad sgrub gzhan phan 'phrin las kun khyab de nyid dgung lo bcu nas rgya mi'i btsan dbang gi 'og nas rgya gar 'phags yul du gdan drangs te/ dpal yul grub dbang pad ma nor bu'i gam du bzhugs nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs dbang 'khrid man ngag dang bcas pa gsan bsam mdzwad de/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'gran zla dang bral ba dgung la bcu bdun thog bod la phyir phebs skabs/ srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog mjal bcar zhus te bod la phyir log mardod/ dgung lo de las son med rung bod rgyal khab dang / mi rigs la bcos min gyi lhag bsam dkar zhing / 7gong sa mchog la dad gus lhag par che ba bcas red/sbra nag dgon pa/ rang sde'i sa khul do mda' lha khang zhes chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos gsar bzhengs mdzad pa'i mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang dang / khyad par du 'tshams kyi yi ge drug ces rgya bza' kong jos rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas bzhengs pa'i 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs sngags yi ge drug ma rgya khyon che la nam yang zub tu med pa dus da lta'ang bzhugs yod/gsum pa dpa' lding 'og la phu la 'brog sde khag gcig dang / rong 1

13 char rlung khrod kyi me stagasde dpa' la'i yar shog dang mar shog g.yu sgron smad khyon sde khag bcu bzhi yod/lding dpon dpa' la dpon tshang zhes gling seng stag a dom gyi mi rgyud yin par grags/ 'thab na dpa' rtsal che ba dang / bsdun na blo khog yangs pa/ pha mes bzang po'i bu rgyud non che ba sogs byung / mchod gnas a rgyan smin grol gling pa'i chos rgyud mkho chen dgon pa bsam gtan gling zhes mkhas grub shes rab 'od zer gyis btab/ de bzhin dpa' yul chos rgyud chos rgyal dgon pa dang / 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi chos brgyud nub dgon slon lam dpal 'byor gling / gna' dus chos rgyal 'phags pa khams la byon skabs byon bzhugs mdzad pa'i nyi shar dgon pa/ ma zad gong gsal ltar gyi 'gro 'dren dgon pa yang ldong 'og 'di'i sa sne na yad cing go rdzong bsam grub stag rtse'i pho brang yang dgon zhol du yod do/'gro 'dren dgon pa'i lha 'bangs nor ma 'brog sde ni dgon 'di'i g.yas g.yon gyi lung pa'i phu rnams su rtswathang gya noms par 'khod do/ de man chod bar lding gsum dang / smad lding gsum sogs rgyus mnga' de tsam med par brten bshad mi shes/yin na'ang / rob tsam zhus na de bzhin bar lding gsum du grags pa'i nang nas/ dang po glan chung lding 'og la 'brog sde khag gnyis dang / rong sde la gshis rta dang / ri rtsib shog phu khag bcas la sde khag dang / lding dpon gzig phrug tshang zhes dpa' mardongs gnyis ldan gyi mi rgyud can las/ glan chung 12

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 13a yi sbo zhes pho rab yongs su grags pa sogs mibargyud bzang po byung yod/ mchod gnas rgya ra dgon pa thub bstan chos 'khor gling mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dge ba'i bzhes gnyen gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu yan tan gyi khur du dud pa ngo mtshar che ba kho na byon/ de bzhin tsha ru dgon pa/ lha ru dgon pa/ lhun grub dpal ri ni thog mar mi pham bstan pa dar rgyas kyis phyag btab gnang ba'i gnas yin/ lding 'og 'di go 'jo sa dkyil lta bu yin/ yul skyong gnyan lha chen po rdo rje ngang dkar zhes pa rong 'brog gi sa mtshams su bzhugs pa go khul khyon yongs kyis rtsacher bdag lha dbang g.yul las rgyal ba lta bu'i gzi mdangs bzod par dka' ba'i ngang tshul du bzhugs/ chu yi snying po sa yi bcud du smin par rang byung gi tsha yi zhing kha sogs rgya chen po yod do/ bar lding gnyis pa a dkar lding 'og la/ chu nyin srib rong sde khag bcu gsum 'brog sde khag gcig bcas dang / lding dpon a dkar dpon tshang mi brgyud khyad par can gna' dus stag lu rgyal po zhes pa 'di yi nye 'gram du byung bar grags/ mchod gnas dpal ldan rgya ra dgon pa yin la/ 'di yi rong khul du a dkar phur pa thang gi gtsug lag khang zhes sngon chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang brgya rtsabargyad kyi ya gyal gcig yin zhing / des ma tshad gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i dal zhal phye nas gangs can 'phungs byed dam sri gdug pa can dam 'og la bcug pa'i gnas khyad par can 3

)4 char rlung khrod kyi me stagazhigo yin pas phuor pa thang zhes yongos su grags/ phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas gtar ma mang pa da 'ag la khyab 'ag khyab par gtams yad/ gang zag khyad par can rnams la gzigs snang mthong tshul du ma yod par bshad/ bar lding gsum pa mod po lding 'og la 'brog sde bla ma 'brog pa/ rong sde mod po gzhung dang /ha tsha/ snya chu phu mda' kun tu rong sde khag lding dpon mod po dpon tshang rigs rus khyad par can/ gtam mkhas la/ bskor na blo bzang / dpa' che ba byung /mchod gnas la lung phug dgon lung rtogs phun tshogs gling sgrub brtson rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang po byon/ klu chu dgon gnyis dpal yul chos rgyud ngo mtshar can byang chub sems pa mang po byon/ di'u dmar dge bzhes zhes sman dang rtsis la mkhas grags can de yang 'di phyogs byon par bas/da/smad lding gsum nas dang po a lding 'og la/ rong sde a nag ra 'bus shing kha gsog dang / wa rtsas gnyis dang / dzo yus/ skya 'bas sogs rong sde khag dang / 'brog sde khag bcas yad cing / a nag dpon tshang zhes dbang 'byor mi rgyud dpa' mardongs shes gsum ldan pa'i phyugs dar rgyal phran dang mnyam pa byung yod/ chos dbyings skya thang nyi ma seng ge zhes nyi zer la na bza' 'gel nus pa'i grub thob chen po de'i gdan sa skya thang dgon/ grub chen mang po byon pa'i gdan sa skyed po dgon bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling dang / thab ra dgon pa de gsum la dpa' yul dgon lag tu bzhugs/ rig pa 'dzin pa bzang ba 14

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 15mang dag cig byon/ rtsasde nam mkha' rdo rje'i gdan sa lding 'og 'di yi rong khul du yad/ gnyis pa chu med lding 'og la/ rong sde chu smad rgyud du chags pa dang / gser kha rong sde khag dang 'brog sde khag lding dpon chu smad dpon zhes mi rgyud lha las chad pas chos dang bla ma la dad mos che/ dpa' mdzangs rtul phod che/ dpon chen ya rabs mang po byon/ mchod gnas sa skya ba'i chos rgyud gdan sa rnying pa gser mdog dgon pa'i gdan sa khyad 'phags rig 'dzin byang chub sems pa khyad 'phags mang po byon no/ smad lding gsum pa rtsi rong lding 'og la rdzirong 'brog sde dang / sa zhing khang gi bdag po/ ljing dpon rtse rong dpon zhes mi rgyud gser ltar bzang zhing / ya rabs kyi srol la mdzad sgo yangs pa'i dpon rabs mang po byon cing / mchod gnas a rgyan smin grol gling pa'i chos rgyud khyad par can mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi blagrwa du ma byon/ gter chen byang chub rdo rje'i gdan sa nyag bladagon zhes rtsirong gser kha mdzo yul gsum gyi sa mdor bzhugs/ 'gro phan thugs bskyed che/ mtshan snyan dang 'phrin las mdo stod khul ha cang khyab che'o/ lar go 'khro'i phyogs 'dir gu ru pad ma'i sbas gnas smar shod bkris rdzong 'go zhes yangs su grags/ a rgyan ya/ba yum gyi sgrub gnas byin chen lung pa'i stod smad kun la mang du yad cing /yul skyong lha klu gzhis bdag kun gu ru pad ma'i tha tshig la gnas pa'i dkar phyogs kyi nga/ma ldan kho na yin/ chos lugs la phyogs ris med cing rgyal bstan 15

1snyo char rlung khrod kyi me stagaris med pa snga nas da bar dar srol che'o/ spyir yul khams 'di yi stod smad kun tu gser dngul zangs lcags sogs rin po che'i gter kha mang yang sa yi bcud g.yang gi rten du 'jog pa las sngog 'don byed pa'i srol sngar nas da lta'i bar du ma dar/ chu thams cad bsil la dwangs bas lus khams bde zhing rig pa gsal/ shing thams cad drang la mkhar gyi bzo dbyibs legs shing / sa rgyu bzhin pa'i zhing thang gi thog 'bru rigs kyi thon khungs legs shing / spang thams cad snum (ra bkra bas phyugs rigs gso spel yong rgyur phan thogs che ba/phu yi ri rnams gangs dang rdza yis bskor ba/ sman rtswa'i skye khungs bzang zhing /ri sked thams cad spang dang me tog gis khyab pas bsam gtan pa'i bsnyi gnas bzang zhing / ri dwags kyis rtsed bro rdung / gzhung thams cad zhing thang dang grong sdes bkangs pa/ yul 'brog thams cad sa sde yis sbrel ba/ tshong las dar zhing rgyas la bza' 'thung longs spyod 'dzoms pa/ mi mang che ba spyod gtsang gzhung drang gi thog nas chos la dad pa che bar rten/ mi gsod 'phrog bcom sogs gyod dang kha mchu med pa'i yul lung bde 'jags ldan pa zhig kyang red la/ rang byung khams kyi madzres rgyan du gyur ba'i ri dwags dang / 'dab chags/ chu nang gi nya rigs sogs gang la'ang 'tshe ba byed pa'i las mtha' dag spangs te/ mi slon rang skyid kyi chog shes ldan pa'i 'jig rten zhig kyang red/bu tshang ma dpa' rtsal rtul phod can sha stag yin pa ma zad/ gzhung sa 6

pha mes kyi regres rus/ 17dga' ldan pho brang la blo gtad yid ches yad pa'i thog phyi yi dgra zon mtha' dag/ la rgol lan g.yul 'argyad bsham rgyur stobs dang ldan pa zhig kyang red/ de ltar na'ang / rgya nag bzhung si/sa bod la btsan 'dzul byas rjes/ rlabs chen gyi mi ribs shig gi mtshon rtags rang bzhin gyi don snying ldan pa'i dgon sde dang / gra tshang / mchod rten/ de bzhin gna' shul gna' rdzas sobs gtor bzhig btang nas da cha rgyang ro tsam zhig ma gtogs shul med bzos/ lo rgyus kyi god chags las byung ba'i rma kha der dran gso byed pa'i tshe/ nga tsho'i mig lam du 'khor ba rni yad tshad gtor zin pa'i kha sang gi skyo gnas dang / de ring re thag chad pa'i rnam pa de las ma 'das/ rang nyid kyi dran thog ltar na/ go 'jo khyo/ no yongs su dgon pa dngo lha khang sogs gtor bzhig phyin pa'i gras su sbo nag dgan pa/ brag nag dgan pa/ bsam 'grub dgan pa// nyag bla dgan pa/de'u dgon pa/ snag yag rtag brtan sgrub sngod/ lung phug dgon pa/ klu chu dgon pa/ rdzong 'go ri khrod/ gser mdog dgon pa/ thang skya dgon pa/skye(smu po dgon pa// tsha ru dgon pa/ skya thang dgon pa/ thab ra dgon pa sogs red/ chos rgyal dgon pa/ mkho khyim dgon pa/ rag 'go dgon pa/ dngul ra dgo/na pa/ rdo rdzong dgon pa/ kha spegs dgon pa/ rgod 'go dgon pa/stag mo dgon pa/ brag 'go dgon pa/ 'gro 'dren dgon pa/ thum dgon tshang gter sras dgon pa bcas ni dus skabs de dag gi nang rang nyid la dngos 17

)8 char rlung khrod kyi me stagasu cha rgyus byung ba'i dngos byung gi gnas tshul yin pa dang / da dung de las mang ba btor bzhig btang yad༈gus mo'i skye yur zur tsam gleng ba la/ gong du brjod pa ltar bdag si pha yul ni mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i rang byung khams kyi khyad nor dang / thon khungs phun sum tshogs la ro bcud ldan pa sogs mchog tu gyur ba'i ༷/la lung 'di lū bu ni dngos 'brel snyan ngag mkhan zhig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/ rin thang ldan pa'i phul byung gi brtsams chos shig la med du mi rung ba'i rgyu cha yin pa dang / thang ga'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas gsar bzhengs byed mkhan gyi lha bzo pa zhig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/ sa 'di ga'i yul ljongs kyi bkod pa dang mchog tu gyur ba'i khyad nor 'di dag ni khong gi ri mo'i sgyu rtsal de dag don dngos gyi 'tsho ba'i nang nas phyir phyungs pa'i gson po'i nyams snang can zhig la snang srid/ rang nyid chung dus su rtsa'athu ru 'gro skabs phrug gu rtsed rogs 'khrid nas rtse rgyur das/'a po yad/ nga tsho'i phyogs kyi ri mang che ba ni sman ri dang // ri de dag gi steng du skyes pa'i rtsayang phal che ba ni sman rtswa yin par bshad/ lo khri stong mang po'i gong rol du nga tshashī mi rigs 'di gangs ljongs sa mtho'i steng du 'tsho gnas byas pa dang / yangs shing rgya che ba'i gangs ljongs kyi ri klung gang sar nam mkha'i skarngeri tshogs sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i phyug rigs kyis bkangs yod pa dang / sa rgyu bzhin pa'i zhing thang gi steng gro nas sran gsum sogs 'bru rigs 18

pha mes kyi rigs rus/ 19kyi thon khungs legs pa/ sa 'og gang sar gser dngul zangs lcags sogs mchog tu gyur ba'i nor bu'i bang mdzwod de lta bu 'jig rten mi yul 'dir mthong dkon par snang / bdag gi pha yul la'ang de dang de lū bu'i mchog tu gyur ba'i khyad nor phun sum tshogs shing / rtswachu'i drin las sems can 'bri g.yag dang /lug mardoo mo/ rta dang drel sogs sha shed rgyas la stobs che ba sogs kyis mi'i mthong snang dod pa/ byams sems can gyi yul mi'i bzhis rgyud des mi rabs nas mi rabs bar ri klung kun du sems can sha ba dang / gla ba/ rgo ba/sa/zig wa mo/ dom sogs rang rang gang 'dod kyi rtsed 'khro'i gar la rol ba/ dgun gyi dus su ri mgo thams cad kha ba'i gos dkar gyis rgyanade 'jig rten gzhan zhig la slebs pa lta bu'i snang ba ster srid/ dus skabs der rgyug chu yang g.yang ṭi'i khang par nyal ba ltar 'khyags rom gyis bcings par byed/de ltar na'ang / yul phyogs kun du bud shing 'bel po yad par brten/ me phung gi mtha' 'khor du nang mi tshang ma rub rub kyis ja chang sogs zas nor kun la longs su spyod par byed/ phran gyi khyem la phru gu nga rang ma gtogs med par brten/ khyim 'dzin nang mi yongs nas rang gi mig 'bras ji bzhin byams skyong byed kyi yad pa dang / dro skyid ldan pa'i chung dus kyi 'tsho ba de dag da cha yid la 'khor dus sems nang skyo snang dang / brjod mi shes pa'i tshor ba yang gi 'dug19

ga41sa pa /byis pa'i dus kyi 'tshar 'ogangs /rgya nag gi dbang sgyur 'og bod mi yangs kyi lus sems gnyis kar chag sgo ji lta— ri byung ba ltar/ bdag gi pha yul dang / khyem tshang / nang mi bcas 8smu'ang de bzhin du chag sgo'i bar chad dang / sdug bsngal gyi me mtsho'i nang lhungs pa'i lo rgyus shig bajiod rgyu yad/ nga tsho'i pha mes kyi dus su mi rgyu zog gsum sogs zas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs po yad kyang / dus da cha yad tshad tshang ma rgya mis btsan 'phrog byas te/ lag la kha phor tsam yang med pa'i sprang po sprang rkyang zhig chags pa de dag la bltas na/ sngar gyi skye bu dam pas gsung pa lngar/ mthon po gnam lta bu/ btsan po thog lta bu/ phyug po gru lū bu/ madzres po lha lū bu/ 'dus pa thams cad mi rtag ste/ bsags pa thams bcad mi rtag ste 'dzad/ da lta'i 'dzam gling gi 'gro ba 'di thams cad kyang / lo brgya tshun la thams cad 'chi ba las gcig kyang lus pa med/ su 20

byis pa'i dus kyi 'tshar longs/ 21dang gang rul yang 'chi ba glo bur du slebs tsa na/ rang dbang skad cig tsam yang med par gcig bur stong / rgyu nor rdzas gnyen nye dang bral༈ bza' 'thung longs spyod thams cad shul du bskyar te mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton pa bzhin du 'gro/ tha na rang gis bskyangs pa'i /sdus kyang shul du bskyur nas 'gro dgos/ zhes gsung pa ji ba'in rang gi mi tshe 'dir de dang de lū bu'i btang snyoms gtan nas med pa'i 'jib rten khams kyi 'gyur ldog de dag mthong dus/ bya ba gang la yang snying po mi 'dug snyam pa'i bcos min gyi bsam blo de dngos 'brel 'khor gyi 'dugabod kyi yul lung kun gyi thon khungs dang rten sa'i srog shing ltabu zhing las dang 'brog las yin pa ltar/ nga tsho'i pha yul du'ang zhing 'brog gnyis ldan gyi (las la 'bad bzhin yad/ gro nas sran gsum gyi gtsos pa'i zhing las kyi thon khungs dang / de min da dung mar nag dang / yung mo sogs yad pa dang / go 'arngo yangs la sa skya dang / nga/ge lugs/ 'brug pa bka' rgyud/ rnying ma bcas kyai dgon sde mang po yad par brten/ tshes bzang dus bzang gi skabs mi tshang ma dgon pa khag la mchod mjal du 'gro ba dang / bsang gsol dge sgrub byed pa/ chos klog pa/ spyir btang byas na pho mo rgan gzhon su dang su yin rung tshang mas lag tu phreng ba thogs kyi yad pa dang / srog gcod bya rgyur shin tu nas 'adzrems zon byed kyi yad/ srog gcod mkhan re gnyis las med pa de dag la yang rigs ngan bshan par ngos 'dzin byas te mtha' ma'i gras la 'jog gi yod/2 /

22 char rlung khrod kyi me stagarigs rus dbye 'byed byed pa'i lta ba de dag deng skabs kyi spyi tshogs 'gro lugs ltar byas pa yin na/ drang bden gyi bya ba zhig ma yin na'ang / lta ba des mi'i rigs kyi skye khams khor yug dang / bdag med srog chags srung skyob bya rgyur phan nus nges can zhig kyang thon yod par brten/ bod mi'i goms srol de dag ni gcig byas na/ spyang drung ldan pa dang blo rig bkra ba'i bya thabs shig kyang red/gus mo'i grong tsho'i nang du dud tshang 58 tsam yad pa dang / grong tsho'i ming la le mda' grong tsho zhes zer zhing / grong tsho'i 'tsho gos kyi rten sa ni gong du brjod pa ltar zhing las dang 'brog la brten gyi yod/ nga rang gi nang yul 'brog gnyis yad/nga tsho'i khyem gyi gzugs dbyibs ni gru bzhi yin pa dang thogs rtseg bzhi ldan red/ 'og rtseg gsum/ phyi bzo gyang / gyang shing gi mtho tshad ni mi gzugs las ring tsam 'dug yang thog rtseg gcig rdo rtsig bcas pha mes kyi dus rabs nas gsar bzhengs byas pa zhig red 'dug yang thog tu mchod khang yin pa dang de'i nang rten gtso bo ni ma hā gu ru'i sku gsum dang / ston pa thugs rje can gyi sku 'dra sum cu so grangs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang phyag na rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs bcas kyi sku 'dra mda' tshad gsum/ de min sgrol ma dang rgyal ba byams pa/ gter chen bsod rgyal dang rdza ka mchog sprul gnyis kyi sku 'dra sogs rin thang bral ba'i rtsache'i dngos rdzas dang sku gsung thugs rten 22

byis pa'i dus kyi 'tshar longs 33mang pa yad pa dang / bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ 'bum sags rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyis bkangs nas yod/ mchod khang der rdza ka mchog sprul gsang yum nga'i pha yi a zhe rgyun du bzhugs kyi yad/ bla ma sku gshegs rjes su khong gi dbang lung man ngag sogs gzhan la 'chad spel gnang srol 'dug bla sprul mang po zhig khong gi sar phebs nas dge sman mdzad srol 'dugar phyogs su srung ma'i mgon khang yod/ gtso bo mgon po tshogs bdag la bstan srung ma rnams kyi sku gsob dang zhal 'bag mang dag 'dug bar rtseg der nyal khang dang rgyal khang / bang mardood/ sazim chung sogs yin pa dang /de'i 'og la thab tshang dang gnyer khang rnams 'dug de rjes 'og shod rnams la sgo phyug sems can sogs 'jog sa red/ de lta bu'i pha mes nas rang la dbang— ba'i rgyu nor dang khang khyim nor rdzas sogs rgya mis gzhung bzhes btang ba dang /dus skabs der nga rang mi gcig la sngod khang spar mthil gyi rgya khyon tsam zhig kyang med par sngod dgos byung / gnas stangs ni nga rang gcig bu ma/ yin par bod yongs la gnas pa'i bod mi phal che bar de dang de lta bu'i dka' ngal 'phrad yad/nga'i khyim la ming gnyis yod pa las 'ga' shas kyis spom mda' tshang zhes brjod kyi yad pa dang / yang 'ga' shas kyis dpon mda' tshang zhes bajiod kyi yod/ le mda' tshang ni de snga go 'jo dpon 'go dgu'i gras yin pa dang /23

24 char rlung khretred kyi me stagamathar kha chu phog nas mi rgyud dang bcas pa chos thog tu bskyal/ de rjes sde pa gzhung gi tsha ba spom mda' nas nga tsho le mda' gzhis ka dang / mi ser bcas gnang ste bka' shog dang / zha mo lcags mda'/ mdzod gos gser po'i phyu pa/ gzhan yang bka' shog rigs mang dag zhig kyang gnang ste/ go 'jo dpon dgu'i gras la bsko bzhag byas/ spom mda' tshang zer ba ming de nas thogs/nga yi mi rgyud ngo ma de red/ nga tsho bdud 'dul gyi rgyud pa red zer srol 'dug/nga tsho der gnas gzhi chags nas mi rabs kha shas phyin zin cing / nga'i pā lags kyi pha la bu khong ma gtogs byung med pa dang / khong la sring mo bzhi yad 'dug bu mo gcig rdza ka mchog sprul gyi gsang yum yin zhing spom mda' tshang lha zhis grags/ yang buo kun bzang sgron ma go 'jo khang gsar tshang la mna' ma sprad yad kyang chung dus nas 'das grongs phyin tshar 'dugabango da srol la khong ni ya mtshan can zhig yad bzo 'dug tshes bzang dus bzang sogs kyi skabs kho mo gcig bu khang pa'i nang sgoms brgyab nas sdod kyi yad pa dang / skabs re yi ge'i gzugs kyi snang brnyan mang po zhig 'char yong gi 'dug zer/ bla ma dang skyes chen dam pa mang pos khong la gzigs mthong chen po gnang gi yad/ yin na'ang / pha ma'i bka' btsan drags nas mna' mar btang yad pa dang / lo gcig tsam yang ma 'khor gong lus khams bde min gyi gnas stangs la brten nas/ mthar rang gi g.yag mo 'khrid de rdza ka 24

byis pa'i dus kyi 'tshar longs 25dgon du bros byol du song yad pa dang / mi ring bar de gar grongs 'dug bla sprul rnams la bsdo rten ma 'byor gong dpon mda' zhi lha grongs nas dag zhing la phyin song zhes bla sprul dag gi zhal nas gsung srol 'dug yang spom mda' bde chen dbang mo zhes a zhe zhig byung 'dug sring mo chung dus nas dge tshul gyi sngom pa zhus/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba mngon gsum rtogs pa'i chos pa rnam dag cig yad pa dang / khrom khog a 'dzom rgyal sras rin po che'i mdun nas lo mang sgom sgrub gnang ste bzhugs/ nga yi pha mgon po nor bus rang la bcu bdun thog khyem 'dzin 'gan 'khur blangs shing / khong ni gzugs stobs che la byad bzhin legs pa dang / ngo gdong dmar spug la sha rtsi nag pa/ phyi nang mi ser gyi bde sdug kun la lta thub pa/ kha mchu brgyab rjes chad pa bcad pa'i rgyu dngos gang zhig yin rung / dgon pa khag la 'bul ba las rang nyid nas dngos rigs sne gcig kyang nyar srol med/ khong gis snga phyi bar gsu ma du bsam rgyu mi mang dang dran rgyu mi mang ma gtogs med par brten/ mi tshang mas khong la gus bkur dang che mthong chen po byed kyi yod la/ de khul gyi dpon phyogs sogs dang yang 'grig po yod/ dus da lta'ang mi dmangs 'du 'dzwoms dang dga' ston spro skyid sogs kyi skabs khong gi phyag las gnang stangs sogs la yang nas yang du mngags brjod byed kyi yad/ lhag par khong ni rang gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs la sha tsha rnam dag byed mkhan zhig dang / de snga shel dkar 25

26 char rlung khrod kyi me stagagling pa'i mda' dpon khams phyogs su phebs pa'i skabs nga tsho'i khyem la lo mang bzhugs myong sku1da 'dug khong dang khro dga' bo sogs dang mnyam du gzhung don bsgrubs pa'i skor yang mang po gsung rgyu yad pa ma zad/ mi dmangs kyi bde rtsadang yul gyi bde 'jags sogs kyi don du kha mchu brgyab pa grangs las 'das/ dper na/ brag g.yab 'khor ra bla ma dang shog khag gi kha mchu lta bu red/ brag g.yab lha srung za ka skor dang / me ngan gu sngas kyi shog khag gnyis dbar la kha chu thug nas mi rta brgya phrag mang po gsod res btang ba dang / mthar phyogs gnyis kas phyin chad rnyog dra mi yong ba'i don du khas len dam bca' bzhagabadag gibla lags chung ngu'i dus nas chang sa brgyab pa dang / a ma lags ni smar khams rgyal tshogs dpon gyi buo yin zhing / khong rgyu stobs che zhing / ma yi rgyud ni ldong be ru nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi rgyud yin pa dang / sngod khang thog rtseg bzhi can yin pa dang / khyon bsngoms khang mig brgyad yad cing khang pa re re'i nang du mchod rdzas dang sku gsung thugs rten/ khyem gyi mkho dgos sogs ma tshang ba med par byur bur bkangs nas yod pa dang / sgo phyugs sems can dang rta drel sogs kyang mang po yod cing / de yang bzhon rta spus legs 15 dang / mdzo mo dang 'bri g.yag sogs bsngoms pas 700 lhag tsam yod/ dā yang dkar po'i do po nyi shu rtsadagu/ gser dang gzi/ g.yu/ byu ru sogs rin chen nor bu'i mgul rgyan sogs mang po yod/ khong la nye 'khor gyi dga' nye spun mched 26

byis pa'i dus kyi 'tshar longs 27mang la/ yul so se'i sde dpon sogs dang mthun lam yod pa'i cha nas kun gyis che mthong dang gus bkur byed yul du gyur/ khong la chung ngu'i dus nas kyang bzhis rgyud bzang la/ mtho dman kun la nye ring chags sdang med pa/ sems rtsa'akhol la drang tshugs ldan pa zhig kyang red/ khong gis khyim gyi las don che chung tshang ma 'gan len dgos par brten/ snga dgong gang du'ang kha 'don bya rgyu sogs ha cang stabs bde zhig las yong gi med/ pā lags kyi sar rgyun du 'brel gtugs byed mkhan gyi mi sna mang po yod pa'i cha nas/ mi de dag gi 'dod mos bzhin skad cha'i le'u 'khrugs nas dus tshod de ltar rdzogs 'gro yi yod/ rjes su sde dge khrom khog a 'dzwoms rgyal sras kyi drung du chos zhu ba 'khrid nas der lo gnyis tsam rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ dus skabs der sems khrid sogs kyi dbang lung man ngag thob par brten/ mthar sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i skabs la'ang thugs dam zhag gsum bsngad pa red/ chu mo bya yi lo ste spyi lo 1933 lor a ma lags la nga skyes pa dang / nga rang phud pa'i da dung bu gcig skyes 'dug kyang de zla ba lngadrug tsam song rjes 'das grongs phyin 'dug a ma lags la phru gu ma skyes par dus tshod ring po song ba'i dbang gis mi rgyud rtsastong mi 'gro ba'i don du chung ma gcig blangs kyang de la yang phru gu skyes mi 'dug nga tsho'i khyim la bu rgyud nga rang gcig po las med par brten/ phyi nang tshang mas nga la gzigs mthong dang byams skyong chen po byed kyi yod pa dang / de rjes rang la brgyad la slebs skabs rig gnas slob sbyong byed 27

28 char rlung khrod kyi me stagapo'i 'go brtsams/ rang lo bcu gnyis bcu gosum tsam gyi dus tshod bar phru gu rtsed rags mang pa dang mnyam du rtsam pa dang / zha/ bu ram/ spags/ sha/ mar sogs 'ukhyer nas nye zhabor gyi me tog yod pa'i ri'i steng du phyin rte/ dri zhim ṣṭa pa'i sna brgya'i me tog gi zhwa mo dang mgul rgyan bzos te rtsed mo rtsebazhin yod/ dus skabs de ni sems nang spro snang dang bde skyid che shos kyi dus skabs shig yin pa ma zad/dus da cha yang skabs de dus kyi gnas tshul rnams yid la dran gyi 'dug bla lags kyis skabs re nga rang la bu'i chas gos g.yog pa dang / me mda' sbyong brdar byed du bcug pa sogs 'a chad 'u thug gi bka' mol yang gsung myong yod/ khong gis khyod rang bu dang khyad par med/ mthar rgya mi mthar sprod gtong dgos red/ de dus khyod kyis rgya mi gsod phod dam zhes gsungs kyi yod/ nga rang chung dus nas chos lugs la dad pa dang bags chags chen po yod mkhan zhig yin par brten/ nga yi a ni dang mnyam du dgon par sngod 'dod yod/ 'bri chu'i shar rgyud kyi khrom khog a 'dzoms chos sgar la 'brug gi rgyal sras 'gyur med rdo rje zer ba sngon smin gro' gling gter chen gyi thugs kyi sprul skur bzhes 'dug khong gis slob ma stong phrag mang por bka' chos gnang ba dang / nga tsho'i yul phyogs khyon yongs nas dad 'dun chen po yod pa dang / nga yi a nee yang khong gi mdun la lo mang bzhugs myong yod/de rjes bla lags kyis a ma lags dang mnyam du rgyal sras mjal bar phebs rtsis yod par brten/ nga rang yang 'gro 'dod chen po yod pa'i cha nas mnyam du phyin pa 28

byis nga/'i dus kyi 'tshar longs / 29yin/ skabs der nga rang lo na bcu bzhir son yod pa dang / lam bar du rta drel ded de phyin pa dang lam du zhag nyi shu rtsabargyad 'gor byung / dus der khyon chos zhu ba mi grangs sum cu lhag tsam yod pa tshang mar dbang lung khrid sogres khyad du 'phags pa'i byin rlabs thob/ khong gi drung nas phyab dang maṇa ḍal sobs mang po bsags pa ma zad/ de min gzhan dag kyang bsab rgyu'i khas len zhus/ nga tsho tshang mar de rupta bu'i skal ba bzang po thob par dga' po byung la dus yun de dag gi ring khyon zla ba gasnyis lhag tsam 'gor yang bdag la cha mtshon/ na nyin banyis tsam gyi dus tshod las 'asor med pa'i tshor ba byung / bka' chos zhu ba'i skal ba bzang po de lta bu thob pa des ra nga nyid chos bya rgyu'i 'dun pa de bas kyang shugs cher phyin te/ rmo bo lags dang ma nyam du blama'i drung du sngod rgyu'i 'dod mos chen po byung yang bzhag ma byung / dus der mirgyud rtsastong mi'agro ba'i ched du mag pa slong rgyu'i 'char gzhi btings nas phyogs mang por 'tshol lta bya bzhin yod pa dang / a ma lags dang zhang po tshang si bsam blo ltar byas pa yin na/ pha mgon nor sku 'tsho bzhugs ring la go 'khro'i mi ser gyi bzhis ka gyong po yin dus buor dka' ngal chen po 'phrad kyi red snyam ste/ smar khams ri shod dpon la gtong rgyu byas/ phran nas gnas tshul de dag rtogs rjes nga tsho'i khang pa'i thog rtseg bzhi pa'i steng gi g.yog rgan tshe bsam khrid de khong la lab rgyu zhig yod/ rogs pa byed robs zhes bshad pas/ khong gis ga re red dam/ gsungs dang zhes zer/ phran mna' mar gtong rdzis 'dug kyang / nga rang chos bya rgyu'i bsam 29

na0 char rlung kho da kyi me stagablo las 'jig rten bya rgyu'i—'dod pa med pas khyed la 'gro lam rgyus mnga' yod pas der skyel rogs zhes bshad par/ kho pas nga 'gro mi phod/ ngas mu mthud de gal srid nga gnas der ma skyel na nga rang thog kha 'di nas mchongs te rang shi brgyag gi yin zhes mchongs grabs byed khul gyis 'jigs snang bskul ba yin/ nga'i 'u thug thabs zad kyi rnam pa de dag mthong skabs kho pa yang zhed thag chod nas de 'dra ma byed dang / ngas skyel chog ces khas len byas/ de rjes phran nas skog skog sud sud kyis rang gi mkho chas rnams chad lus med par sdog pa dang / sa rub pa dang nang mi nyal zin nas tshuod gcig tsam song rjes byang sgo rgyud nas bros phyin/ de rjes dmar chu bcad nas mtho rengs tsam la dpal la'i mnga' sde rtsong 'bu rong zhes pa'i grong tsho der khong gi ngo shes shig yod pa der bsdad/ phyi nyin snga por a nag dpon gyi mnga' sde'i grong tsho zhig gi nang du spun nye a chung tshang sar phyin te rang nyid dgon par 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gnas lugs rnams bshad par/ khong gis dpon tshang la phru gu gcig las med pas de yang bag mar btang / dpon tshang gi mi rgyud stongs na gang 'dra byed kyi yin nam zhes hon 'thor 'thor byed kyi 'dug de'i phyi nyin za bca' dang bzhon rta bcas 'dang nges bzhin bskur nas lam bar du skyel ma byas pa dang go sde sa mtshams la nyin gcig zhag sdod byas/ phyi nyin nam langs te zhogs ja btung ma tshar gong nas bla go a ja dang / chung mdud tsheng rdo rje sogs mi brgyad 'byor/ skabs der phran nas gsang spyod nang nas bros 'gro rgyu'i grabs bshom byas 30

byis pa'i dus kyi 'tshar longs 31kyang / rgyab nas 'jus te thar ma byung / phyis su bla lags kyis buo khyed rang da res ma 'gro dang / rjes su a 'dzwoms rgyal sras sar btang chog ces nga la khas len byas/ de rjes lo gnyis tsam song dus a ṇi lags dang mnyam du rgyal sras rin po che thengs gnyis pa mjal rgyu'i go skabs thob byung / rin po che'i drung nas dbang lung man ngag gi bka' khrid mang po zhu ba'i go skabs dmigs bsal can thob pa ma zad dus yun zla ngo gsum tsam rgyun sdod byas/ de rjes pha mar khas len zhus pa ltar phyir log byas/ dbyar zla drug pa'i nang 'brog sar nang mi tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms kyi thog nas dga' skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho bar rol bzhin yod pa ltar/ bla lags kyis kyang phran la sha tsha dang bcas te pha ma yad dus dngos 'brel skyid po red/ rang gi 'dod pa gzhir bzung skyid po gyis/ zhes yang yang brjod kyi yad la/ nga rang gi bsam pa'i 'char sgor yang spro snang ldan pa'i snang ba 'char gyi 'dug sngar song gi lo rgyus rnams de ltaratshoyid la 'khor ba dang / byung rabs la posam gzhigs byed pa'i skabs da cha rang nyid gcig bu lus pa red/gnas tshul de dag/ la bsam na tshe 'di'i bya ba thams bcad ni bzang ngan kun rtog gi rmi lam dang gnyis su med pa zhig rang red/ dbyar dus kyi rong 'brog khul du tshes bzang dus bzang gi skabs lha bsang gtong ba dang / rta rgyug pa/ glu len gar 'khrab sogs byas te mi smon rang skyid dang chog shes ldan pa'i 'tsho ba zhig bskyal gyi yod/3 1

tshon2 char rlung khrod kyi me stagade rjes bla lags dang nang mis mos mthun byas pa dang sbrags phran dang agalags a 'dzoms chos sgar blama'i skumadun du lo gcig tsamasdod rgyu'i go skabs byung /rgyal sras rin po ches gsung gsal ltar na/ a ma gnas skabs 'di gar bsdad nas 'khrid bskyang na 'grigs kyi red/ khyed rang da ltalo chung chung yin pas rjes la ga dus yong na'ang 'grigs kyi red/ gal te yong ma thub pa'i dbang du btang na'ang rang gi dad pa'i rjes su drangs na khyad par gang yang med ces gsungs nas blama'i phyag g.yas pas nga yi mgo la bzhag nas smon lam mang po gsungs pa dang / rang ngos nas kyang snying nas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas smon lam btab pa yin/ nga rang phyir log byed pa'i skabs tmams sge'u khung nang nas zhal 'dzum dang bcas te dbu lcog lcog gnang bzhin 'dug pas/ dga' skye'i mchi mas bkangs te mdun gyi lam yang mthong mi thub par gyur/ de ni phran gyis blam mjal ba'i go skabs mtha' ma de red/ dus der nga rang lo na bcu dgur slebs yod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 'khor bar snying po gang yang med pa'i cha nas chos pa rnam dag cig bya 'dod yod/ yin na'ang /bsam pa dang don dngos kyiganas tshul mang po ni rbad de tha dad yin par brten/ bdag gi miche'i nang gi dus tshod yag shos de dag rgya mi'i btsuon khang gi nang du zad pa ma zad/nga rang ma gtogs go 'jio spom mda' tshang gi mi rgyud da nas bzung rtsastong phyin zin pa red/ yin na'ang / de la blo'agyod sogs gang yang med/32

gargyu/ma pa /khams sda'i rgya rgol dmag 'thab /go 'jo dpon khag dgu de dag gi spyi 'doms mtshon bod gzhung gi rdzong dpon re bsko rdzong gnang gi yod par/ yul mi dang dpon 'bangs kun mgo 'og lus chud kyi dpe ltar/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi bka' bkod ltar/yul gyi bde 'arngags dang / khrims srung / khral mjal sogs spyi tshogs kyi byed sgo gang zhig yin rung / tshang mas rang don rang gces dang / bla na med pa'i rgyal 'bangs kyi 'du shes ma dor bar zhabs 'debs rim par sgrub yad pa dang / spom mda' mgon nor gyi sku dus su de bas kyang mnga' thang yar rgyas ldan pa'i rnam pa gsar pa zhig tu gyur yad kyang / rgya nag gung khran tang gis bod la drag po'i btsan 'dzul byas rjes rnam pa bzang po de dag rang yal du gyur song / dus skabs der 'bri chu'i nub rgyud du gnas pa'i mdo stod mnga' khul gyi rdzong sazhis bco brgyad so sor rgya mis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zhes 33

rke4 char rlung khrod kyi me stagapa dril bsgrags byed pa dang / rgya bod zung 'brel gyi u yan lhan khang zhes pa gsar du btsugs te de snga'i lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyi thog nas las don sgrub pa'i bod gzhung gi las don tshang mar the jus byas/ dus der phran gyi pha u yan lhan khang de'i 'gan 'dzin gyi gtso 'gan 'khur bzhin yad/rgya nag gi dbang shugs bod la thog mar yong skabs ma'o tse tung gi thad ka'i bkod 'doms 'os/ nga tsho tshang ma bod mi mang la zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang rogs ram gyi ched du yang pa yin pas khyed tshos zhed snang dang sems khral gang yang byed dgos don med/ gung khran tang gis dgon/ sde grwa tshang dang rten sku gsung thugs rten la sogs pa gtor bzhig gtong gi red ces pa de dag ni go min tang log spyod shog khag dang / btsan rgyal ring lugs dang de'i rgyug khyi tshos dbyen sbyor dkrug shing brgyab pa zhig red/ bod ljongs yar rgyas dang 'dzugs skrun zin 'phral nga tsho tshang ma phyir log byed kyi red ces brjod yad/'on kyang / bya spyod dang lag len dngos kyi thog la slebs skabs gung khran tang gi kha zhe mi mtshungs pa dang / drang bden dang mun nag gi cha de dag rim bzhin phyi ru mngon pa ste/ 1955 lor 'bri chu'i thar phyogs su yad pa'i dar rtse mdo dang / 'jus pa/ sa tham sogs su dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur zhes pa lag bstar byas te/ dgon sde grwa tshang dang rten sku gsung thugs rten la sogs gtor bzhig btang ba dang / rgyu dngos po 'phrog bcom byed pa 34

khams pa'i rgya sgo la dmag 'thab/ 35sogs kyi gnas tshul rnams rim bzhin 'bri chu'i nub ngos su yod pa'i mdo stod mnga' khul gyi sa gnas gang sar khyab pa dang chabs cig de khul la'ang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur zhes pa de ma skul dang blangs kyi thog nas gtong dgos pa'i dril bsgrags byas/ yo lang che ba'i las 'gul de 'dra'i 'og go 'jo rdzong khul gyi mtho rim mi sna rnams dang / bla dpon/ de min mi ser dkyus ma sogs tshang ma'i se mas la blo yi yul las 'das pa'i lam srol der mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byed dgos pa'i blang bya shugs chen bton pa red/ spyo la 1955 lo mjug la slebs skabs mdo stod rdzong gzhis khag gi dbu 'dzin dang / gnad yod mi sna/ de min bla dpon tshos mi dmangs skul slong byas de yang nas yang du 'char ba/zhi mang po bting / dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen yag po yad pa'i khyem tshang re nas mi rta rang 'grig gsum re dang / 'bring bas mi rta go lag dang bcas pa cha gnyis re 'gan len bya rgyu'i gros chod bzhag 1955lo'i lo mjug tu chab mdor yang pa'i rgya bod zung 'brel u yan lhan khang gi bka' btang ba ltar/ rdzong gzhis khag gi kru'u rin rgan gzhon dang / bla dpon mi drag khag gi 'thus mi rnams chab mdor 'du 'dzoms byas te/ nyin shas ring dmangs gso'i bcos bsgyur btang na legs zhes pa'i mang tshogs skul slong byed pa'i gzhi rgya che ba'i tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa dang / tshogs 'du'i thog bod skyod rgya dpon wang ching min gyis dmangs gce'i bcos bsgyur gtong dgos lugs 35

⑨6 char rlung khrod kyi me stag kyi gtam bshad mang po byas pa dang / gal te/ zhi ba'i thog nas gtong ma thub na drag po'i thog nas gtong dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bcangs/ wang ching min gyi gtam bshad de dag la 'thus mi rnams dang mi mang tshos mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ bod gzhung gi bka' dgongs ji ltar phebs pa dang / bod mi mang gi 'dod 'dun ji 'dra yin pa bcas la zhib 'jug gastang zab kyi thog nas kho tsho'i bsam 'dun gzhir bzung bya dgos pa las/ rgya mi'i 'dod pa ltar bcos bsgyur byed pa sogs la dang len rtsab nas med lugs kyi nan brjod byas pa dang dus mtshungs/ smar khams phu pa dpon dang / brag yab go bo gnyer pa/ mkhar mdo gnyer pa/ ra ru bstan rnam/ bdag gi pha mgon po nor bu bcas kyis tshogs 'du'i thog tu gtam bshad spel te/ gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis rgya nag gzhung gis bcos bsgyur bya rgyu'i ngan jus khag la rgol lan bslogs pa dang / phran gyi pha yis rgya mi'i 'go khrid dang gnas yod mi sna rnams kyi bcos ma'i ji 'bag gi gdong ris dmar rjen du bton pa dang / khyed tsho phag dang gcig pa red ces tshig ngan mang po bshad pa'i dbang gis rgya dpon rnams nga rgyal dang khong khro'i gzhan dbang du gyur te/ rkub stegs kyi steng du'ang sngod thub kyi mi 'dug ces pa'i lo rgyus mang po bshad rgyu 'dug skabs der tshogs 'du grol rjes mdo stod rdzong gzhis khag gi 'go khrid rnams nas mna' tshig dam bca' bzhag pa dang / de'i khongs su sde dge 'jo mda' rdzong gi mkhar mdo gnyer 36

khams pa'i rgya rgol dmag 'thab/ 37pa 'chi med mgon po dang / ra ru bstan rnam/ brag yab tshang gi sku tshab go bo gnyer pa/ kho ra bla ma/ 'thus bo gnyer pa/ smar khams rdzong gi chu 'bum phu pa dpon/ go 'ardoo rdzong gi spom mda' dpon mgon nor/ a nag dpon sogs yad pa red/ khong rnams kyis go 'jo rdzong dang / brag g.yab kyi sa mtshams chu gnyis mdo zhes pa der rgya dmag btsan 'dzul pa mthar bkrod gtong slad sra zhing brtan pa'i rgyal srung g.yul 'argyad dang / de min gyi las 'gul sna tshogs spel rgyu'i gra sgrig byas pa dper na/ rgya dmag gi lam bzo dang / ar las/bdal gtong skyel 'dren/ dngos zog mkho sgrubs bya rgyu pakag sngom bya rgyu'i gros chod dang / tha na khams phyogs su ming grags che ba'i ko dmar khrag 'bog ces pa'i mna' gan mthu mo zhes pa'ang bzhagarang yul go 'jo rdzong du phyir lag zin rjes su 'bri chu'i shar ngos kyi gnas tshul rnams rim bzhin dzwa drag can du 'gyur bzhin pa'i khar/ 1958gro'i lo stod du slebs skabs a mdo dang / tree hor/ nyag rong / li thang /gling kha shis sogs kyi sa gnas gang sar rgya mis btsan shed kyis bcos bsgyur bya 'go tshugs pa dang / deng dus can gyi go mtshon thogs pa'i rgya mi'i drag shugs kyis bod mi rnams la bas ma yul las 'das pa'i drag gnon dang / 'dzin bzung btson 'jug do dam bkag nyar byed pa dang dus mtshungs/ lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa dang rin thang bral ba'i rig gnas dngos rdzas dang / dgon sde/ lha 37

rke8 char rlung khrod kyi me stagakhang sogs la bsam yul las 'das pa'i gtor bcom byas/ bcos bsgyur dang rogs ram gyi ming thog nas bod la btsan 'dzul byed par yong ba'i rgya dmag gi gdug rtsub che ba'i don da ngos kyi bzhin ras de dag rim bzhin phyi ru mngon pa dang chabs cig rgya che'i mang tshogs kyis kyang rang yul srung skyob kyi don du dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs byas/go 'jo rdzong gi rdzong dpon dang mi mang yangs kyis btsan rgol dmag 'khrug nang zhugs rgyu'i grabs bzhom byas pa dang / go 'jo'i rdzong khongs su chu smad dpon rdo rje sri thar/ rtsi rong dpon/ a nag dpon 'phrin las/ mod po dngo na mgon po rdo rje/ a dkar dpon/ glan chung dpon nyi ma/ dpa' la dpon 'jigs med mgon po/ khang gsar dpon mgon po bsam grub/ spom mda' dpon mgon nor bcas dpon khag dgu dang / yul lung nang gi mi drag dang shes ldan mi sna/ mi mang dkyus ma bcas kyis go 'jo khul du ming grags che ba'i rtsache'i gzhis bdag rdo rje ngang dkar mdun du 'du 'dzoms byas te/ mna' tshig dam bca' bzhag pa dang dus mtshungs 'char gzhi ldan la go rim yod pa'i sgo nas dpon 'go so se'i khyab khongs nas dmag bsdu'i skul slong byas te/ rgya mi'i bkod byus la 'gog rgol bya rgyu dang de min rgya dmag dbung skyod byed ched gsar skrun byas pa'i gzhung lam khag la dngos shugs rgyud gsum nas phan nus ldan pa'i bkag 'gog bya rgyu/ dpon dmangs gong 'og tshang mas rdog rtsagacig 38

khams pa'e rgya rnol dmag 'thab 39tu bsgril dgos pa dang / bya thabs nan tan spyod dgos pa/ bod 'di bzhin gnya' khri btsan po'i dus skabs nas kyang rang btsan gtsang ma'i rgyal khab cig yin pa lo rgyus kyi ra spuod byed bzhin yod pa ltar na/ mchog tu gyur ba'i rang gi mes po'i rgyal khab 'di bzhin rgya dmag gis nam yang btsan 'dzul byed du 'jug mi rung zhes dpon dmangs yongs kyis ma gros bsam pa gcig tu mthun nas dam bca' bzhagayang 1957 lor go 'jo rdzong 'og khang gsar dpon gyi sa gnas lha thog 'brog sde rgya mtsho lte ba zhes pa'i khul der rgyal srung dmag dpung dbar phan tshun dam tshig rdog rtsagacig sgril yong ched du go 'jo rdzong dang / gling gzhis 'chi med rdo rje dmag shog smar khams chung 'bum dgon yul gsum/ rgyal tshogs dpon dmag gtsos pa'i smar khams sa khul gyi dmag dpung bcas nas rgya dmag btsan 'dzul pa la 'gog rgol kha gtad gcog rgyu dang / nang du phan tshun gcig phan gcig grogs bya rgyu las nang khul phyogs zhen 'then 'khyer dang /nang 'khrug sogs kyi dbang du ma song ba bya rgyu'i dam bca' dang gros chod bzhagadus skabs der go 'jo rdzong 'og gi sku tshab a nag dpon 'phrin las/ go 'jo kha legs mchog sprul pad ma kun bzang rang grol/ btson ming pad ma bde chen zer/ khong yul byol gyis dpal 'bar du phebs skabs rgya mis khong dmag spyi byas par bsnyad btags nas mi lo nyi shu lhag tsam btson khang du bcug pa ma 39

40 char rlung khrod kyi me stagazad/ 'thab rtsod dang dka' sdug mang po myangs yad/ mthar btson grol byung nas lo gsum bzhi tsam ring bstan dang 'gro bar phan pa'i phyag las rgyun mthud de mdzad pa red/ khang gsar dpon sogs bla dpon sku tshab rnams dang / smar khums phu po dpon sku tshab nang blon bu khe bsam gtan/ sku srung lding dpon byams pa bcas yad/skabs der phran gyi pha mgon po nor bu lags snyun gzhi phog yod kyang /rgya dmar btsan 'dzul pa'i smyo ham can gyi rang bzhis ngan pas gang sar kla blo'i rtsub spyod de dag 'bri chu'i shar nub gang sar lag star bya bzhin yad pa'i thogadamag shugs kyang sngar las lhag pa'i 'phar snon gyis bod kyi rgyal bstan chab srid dza drag can du gyur bar brten/ khong gis nga na tsha las drag skyed byung tshe stod phyogs rgya mi'i go mdzod che shos de gtor de spom mda' mgon nor gyis 'di byas song ther ba zhig ma byas na 'grig thabs med ces yang nas yang du brjod bzhin par mthar rkyen 'das su phyin/ dus der khong dgung grangs 42 las son med/ khong 'das grongs ma song gong gi snga nub tu gsung par lha sar nga tsho mdo stod dpon 'go rnams kyis rgyal ba rin po che'i gzim chung mardzal kha thob ska bas thugs dgyes zhal 'dzum mdangs dang bcas te spyan gyis nga tshor gzigs bzhin gsung gleng mdzad/ 'bras sil gnang / 'gro khar nga tsho la kha btags dang dar gos chen thag sne re gnang / spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag nga tsho'i mgo 40

lams pa'i rgya rgol dmag 'thab/ 41la bzhag gnang mardod byung / nga rang nas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab ste slon lam brgyab/ gang gi mdun nas phyir kha skor dus sems nang skyo ba drag po skyes pa dang chabs cig mig nas rang dbang med par mchi ma shor/ a ṇi rig 'dzin dang nga gnyis yang mnyam du ngu shor/ da ni rngorgyal ba rin po che dang bod 'di bzhin rgya mi'i dbang 'og tu shor rgyu'i nyen kha ha cang chen po 'dug ces yang yang gsung gi 'dugadus skabs der rgya dmag dang go 'jo smad du dmag 'thab drag po byed bzhin pa'i sgang than pa dang / yab mgon nor mchog 'das grongs 'gro skabs gus mo rang lo nyer bzhir son/ gus mos shul 'dzin gyi thog nas go 'jo khul gyi dpon khag tsho dang mnyam du de snga'i mna' gan gzhir bzung so so'i khyab khongs mi dmangs la dmag skul dmag grabs kyi las don gang dgos ji bzhin dang blangs byas pa ma zad/ go 'jo smad phyogs sa la nyag bla ma byang chub rdo rje mdun du phran gyi pha 'das po'i rjes la phyag dang mchod 'bul sogs dge sgrub kyi las gang bya dgos min gyi thad la skyabs 'jug zhus par/ rin po ches dpon ni rig 'dzin gyi gral du phyin tshar song / de sgrub dgos bsam na bsgrub na 'grig ces bsgrub rgyu 'ga' shas gsungs zhor/ khyed tsho spom lding 'og dpon gyi mi sems 'gul ba'i bka' drin 'og sde dpon gra 'grig la go mtshon legs pa dang / mi rta hrag pa sogs go 'jo nang khul nas mthun rkyen 'ardooms shos yin 41

42 char rlung khrod kyi me stagapas na/ bod bstan srid kyi don du las ka yag po byed dgos zhes bka' slob mang dag cig gsungs pa ma zad/ khong nas phyag mdud 150 dang / na bza' shog chags 150 srung ba sa tswa 150 bcas gnang ba dang rang nyid la da dung tshe dbang tshe 'gug kyang mdzod byung /spom mda' lding 'ogo la mi ser 600 lhag tsam yad cing / de sngo pha bzhugs dus nas kyang ga 'ja smad la rango dmag gtang mus muo mthud rong 'ag nas dmag bsdu dang / dmag sar gtang rgyu sags dpan 'ag sa sas rang sa rang srung bya rgyu'i 'char 'god ji bzhin lag star byas te/ nga tsho'i nye 'gram du yod pa'i na chen thang zhes pa'i thang chen de'i thog mi rta go lag rang 'grig dmag dang bcas pa 'du 'dzwoms byas pa dang / dngul ra dgon pa dang / rda rdzong dgon pa/ kha legs dgon pa bcas kyi ming grags che ba'i bla sprul rnams gdan drangs nas lha bsang gtong ba dang / mi rtar rab gnas gnang / de rjes nga rang gi dmag rnams 'khrid nas 'gro skabs der nga'i bzhon rta ni yang zing phrug phrug zhes pa'i spu mdog bra'u yin pa dang sha shed bzang / yul pa dang 'brog pa gnyis kyi sa mtshams la sgar btab ste rang sa rang srung byas/ phran gyi pa pha ma grongs gong go khul sa gnas khyon yangs la rgya mi gcig kyang med pa bzo rgyu'ichod sems bzhag skabs der rgya mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dugade'i rgyu mtshan gang yin min dran gyi mi 'dug gling gzhis 'chi mid rdo rje dpon 42

khams pa'i rgya rgol dmag 'thab/ 43dmag rnams dang / sga rje dpon mo tshe ring dpal mo dpon dmag phu pa dpon yul dgon gsum gyi dpon dmag 1959 lor sde dge rgyal sras dbus rgya mkhar dpon mgon rnams/ 'og ma dpon rigs rnams/ a rgyan rdo rje/ ngan 'phrad dpon dmag gyang khang dpon dge stobs gtsos dpon dmag sogs rim bzhin go 'jor 'du 'ardooms byung / de dus go 'arngo spyi dang yang sgos nga tsho'i 'bros sde khag nas dmag rgyag rogs ram mkho sprod byas/ 1958 lor dpon mgon nor 'das grongs song rjes su rgya dmag gis go 'jo khul du dzwa drag che ba'i drag po'i dpung 'jug byas te nga tsho'i gnas babs nyin bzhin rje zhan rje sdug tu 'gro bzhin yad par brten/ go khul khyon yongs kyis rang sa rang srung gi don du gros chod bzhag gros chod kyi gtan 'bebs ltar sa khul khag gi dpon dmag yongs kyis rgya dmag dang bsdud mar lo gcig yas mas kyi dmag 'thab byas/ de ltar na'ang / dmag don gyi stobs shugs dang / mtshon cha legs nyes/ mdel rdzas bzang zhan/ rgyab phyogs kyi dpung snon dang mkho sgrub skyel 'dren gyi cha rkyen bzang zhan gyi bar khyad shor ba'i dbang gis dgra bo'i tshur rgol mtha' dag la 'gog rgol ma thub pa dang / lhag par du sa ngos byang thang du rgya mi'i me sgyogs dang gnam gru sogs shugs drag che ba'i dbang gis a dkar dpon dang / mod po dpon sogs dpon dmag mi nyung ba zhig skabs de'i dmag 'khrug gi nang tshe srog shor/ de dang chabs cig tu dgra bo'i dmag 43

44 char rlung khrod kyi me stagadapung la'ang god chag chen po byung ste dmag mi chig stong lhag tsam gyi tshe srog shor bar grags/ skabs der da dung go 'jo stod smad kyi mi hrag rta hrag rnams ri 'gor bsdad yad kyang / mi ser rnams rgya mi'i dmag gis mnan nas bsngad yad/ dus der nga tsho nang blon zhang po 'chi mid rdo rje brgyud de rgya mis yi ge thengs kha shas bskur ba'i nang / khyed dang khyed kyi nang mi tshang ma mar log shogargyu nor sogs la nyes skyon mi yang ba'i 'gan len byas chog la/ de tsam ma zad go lag kyang tshang ma rtsis sprod byed dgos/ de ltar byas na/ go gnas sprod rgyu yin zhes 'khod 'dug yi ge de mthong dus kho tsho'i bsam blo ji bzhin mgo btabs zhu rgyu las ldog ste/ zhe 'khon gyi rma kha de bas che ru phyin pa ma zad/ nga tsho go 'jo khul du rgya mis mi bsad rta 'gyel dang bsregs gsod 'phrog bcom byas pa'i yid skyo ba'i bya ba rnams yid la 'char ba dang / de bas phran gyi pha yis gsungs pa'i bslab bya zhig ste/ 7rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bu dang bod rgyal khab dang mi rigs la gus brtsi dga' zhen dgos pa dang / bstan srid rang dbang gi don du srog blos gtong thub na skyes pho rab red/ gung khran tang ni gangs ljongs mi rigs dang chos srid kyi bstan dgra gcig bu de red/ gung khran tang gi bslu brid kyi skad char nyan rgyu nam yang med ces pa'i bslab bya de dag nga yi yid la 'khor skabs/ da ni rgyun ring ri la sngod pa las rgya mi dang mu mthud de 'thab rtsod byas te rang gi lus po 'di blos btang na dga' snyam/ de tsam 44

khams pa'i rgya sol dmag 'thab 45ma zad nga tsho'i go mtshon sogs rtsis sprod kyis mgo btags zhu dgos zer ba de ni rbad de nga rang bud med gcig la zhin tu nas mthong chung byas pa red bsam nas rgya mis 'dzin bzung ma byas bar du mgo btags zhus med/ de dang dus mtshungs 'bri chu'i nub rgyud du yad pa'i sde dge rgyal sras sku 'khor dang / 'og ma rig rnam/ rgya mkhar dpon mgon rnam/ ngan 'phrad blo dga'/ gyang khang dge stobs kyis gtso bor gyur ba'i dpon dmag chig stong yas mas shig nga tsho'i sa gnas su 'byor byung bas sde dge dpon dmag dang / gling gzhis dpon dmagago 'jo a nag dpon 'phrin las sogs nga tsho dpung shugs gcig bsgril byas te stod phyogs su 'gro rgyu byas/ 'on kyang / dus der go 'jo smad phyogs kyai dpon dmag thog rgya dmag gis 'arngab rgol byas pa'i dbang gis nga tsho mnyam du slebs ma thub par kha 'thor ba red/ gong ltar mdo stod khang gsar dpon dmag dang spom mda' lding 'og nga tsho dpon khag gnyis kyi dpung dmag lhag 'phros rnams phyogs gcig la zla bsgril btang ste/ mna' gan bzhag pa ltar lag star byas/ nga tsho 'brog sa dang kha bral nas bar thag gang 'tshams slebs dus sa srod la mo phog tsam nas rgya dmag gis kong khu phyogs kyi ri rtse nas nga tshor kha phyogs te me mda' sbag sbag brgyab byung bas/ nga tsho'i rta drel rnams kyang 'drogs 'go langs shing rgyab chas dang 'khal ma rang 'grigs 'khyer de 'brog pa'i sar bros shor ba dang / de rjes nga tsho khag cig sngon la bskyod pa dang mi hrag khag cig 45

4snyo char rlung khrod kyi me stagasgrigs 'dzugs bzos nas ri gdong g.yas g.yon du phan tshun kha gram zhing bltas te bsngad pa'i skabs der/ rgya dmag rnams ri las babs te nga tsho'i phyogs su kha gtad de yang bzhin 'dug dus der nga tshos rgya dmag la kha phyogs nas me mda' 'ga' shas brgyab pas kho tsho de nas phyir bshol byas/ de ltar na'ang nga tsho yul grong khag dang kha bral nas bsngad yod pa'i dbang gis rang rang so so'i mdel rdzas la gron chung dang bsri tshags byed dgos par brten gang byung gis me mda' rgyag rgyur tshod 'dzin nan tan byas/ nga tsho'i sngon la phyin zin pa'i mi rnams mig gis mthong rgyu mi 'dug kyang kho tsho'i bskyod shul rnams la rjes 'ded byas te phyin pas mthar kho tsho'i rjes zin/ de'i dgong mo gling gzhis dpon dmag dang snge dge rgyal sras sku 'khor dpon dmag rnams sngon ma'i 'char gzhi ltar mnyam 'dzwoms byung / sde dge rgyal sras sku 'khor dang snge dge tshang gi dmag sgar thog tu rgya dmag gis mkha' thog dang sa ngos gang sa nas gtor rgol shugs chen byas pa'i dbang gis dpon dmag mang po zhig dmag sar 'das grongs phyin pa dang / gson por lhag pa rnams kyang tshang ma kha 'thor ya gral du gyur nas sde dge rgyal sras sku 'khor nga tsho'i sa khul du 'byor/ sde dge rgyal sras mdun 'khor 'og ma rig rnam dang phran gyi pha phan tshun mna' gan bzhag yad pa dang /de bzhin smar khams phu pa dpon nas thad ka'i bkod 'doms gnang ba'i dmag dpung khag gcig dang mnyam 'dzoms byung ba'i skabs der gong gsal gyi dbu 46

khams pa'i rgya rgol dmag 'thab/ 47khrid mi sna rnams ca rtswal 'dzoms thog rgya mir kha gtad bcog stangs skor la gros bsdur mardod skabs tshang ma'i lta stangs gcig gyur la/ rgya dmag gis mkha' thog dang / sa thog gnyis nas shugs drag che ba'i tshur rgol byed bzhin yod par brten/ sa ngos byang thang thog dmag shugs gcig sgril gyis rang srung bya mi thub pa ma—zad/ dmag rgyags dang rgyab phyogs mkho sgrub kyi cha rkyen mkho sprod dka' bar brten/ nges med rgol rdung lta bu'i kha 'thor gyi dmag 'khrug spyad na legs pa'i dgongs tshul gcig gyur byung ste/ gling gzhis dang go 'jo sogs kyi gong gsal dpon dmag rnams brag g.yab phyogs su dpung bskyod byed bzhin pa'i skabs brag g.yab 'brog khul gser gzhung thang zhes par sgar btab nas bsngad/ skabs der ri 'go khag la so blta byed mkhan bzhag yod kyang / snga dro nam langs te nyi ma shar dus nga tsho'i sgar pa'i mi mang che ba nyal nas bsdad 'dug mi 'ga' shas kyi zhogs ja bskol ba'i gra sgrig byed pa'i skabs rgya dmag gis glo bur du 'jab rgol byas te me sgyogs 'phangs pa dang / de nas me mda' sbag sbag brgyab ste rgya dmag stong phrag kha shas kyis nga tshor mtha' bskor te dza drag che ba'i dmag 'thab shugs chen byas pa'i mthar rgya dmag gis 'gag sgo gtor te nga tsho'i phyogs su rgyugs yang dus/ ca dngos rgyu nor tshang ma yang bskyar der shor ba dang / phru gu dang de min mi rgan pa 'ga' shas la lham yang gyon long ma byung la/ tha na rta'i sga yang brgyab long byung mi 'dug mi so se'i mi rta rang 'grig tsam ma gtogs 47

48 char rlung khrod kyi me stagarta drel mang che ba der shor/ nga tshos lung shur rgyud de phyin pa dang la nyag cig gi sgang nas ngal gso brgyab nas rgyang blta byed pa'i skabs/ nga tshos sgar btab sa'i gnas der rgya mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug dus der nga tshor za chas sogs thur ma gang tsam yang med pas za rgyu med na 'gro thabs ci sku1da bsam ste/nga dang kun bzang gis thur rgyugs glod de sgar btab sa'i phyogs der rgyugs phyin pas nga tsho'i ca dngos tshang ma der bzhag 'dug yin na'ang / de gar mi su gcig kyang mi 'dug pas rtsam pa dang sha mar sogs rta re la 'khyogs tshad re bkal ba'i thog da dung de'i sgang la mi bzhon nas yang / de nas yar tsam nas nga'i drel sha ba ra mo zer ba zhig yad pa des sga stong pa zhig 'khyer nas nged gnyis kyi sar rgyugs yang bzhin 'dug pas nged gnyis rta las babs te/ ca dngos 'ga' shas drel la bkal te 'gro ba'i skabs nga tsho'i mi yang mang che ba 'gro bzhin 'dug pa dang / sngon la so lta byed mkhan dang de rjes mi hrag rnams phyin/ nga rang phyi bshol byas te rjes la phyin pas/ dus der nga yi brtse ba'i grogs mo ste gling gzhis 'chi mid rdo rje'i tsha mo sgang gi dpon tshang tshe ring dpa' mo'i sras mo bde skyong dang ngo 'phrad byung zhing / kho mo nga'i phyogs la sems khral chen po byung 'dug kho mos bajiod don khyed nyid rang mgo thon yad med sngon 'byor gyi mi rnams la dris par da lta rjes la yang gi yad lab kyi 'dug ces brjod/ khong gzugs stobs 'bring tsam yod pa dang byad gzugs legs la bzhis rgyud 'jam 48
